name: Voicevelo G Major
why_interesting: A race-gravel frameset with a 790 g claim, external-bearing T47 and clearance for 700×47C or 650B×2.1 tires.
missing: Published carbon fiber grade, resin system or ply schedule

facts.frame: Carbon frame; 12×100 / 12×142 mm thru axles; flat-mount disc
facts.frame_material: Carbon fiber; the maker does not publish a fiber supplier, grade, resin system or ply schedule. VG1 is a paint designation, not a carbon grade.
facts.frame_construction: Impact-strength-priority tube shaping uses smaller profiles and locally thicker walls; an SAS compliance zone combines the flat top tube, seatstays and lower seat tube, with a pre-embedded T47 shell
facts.stiffness_evidence: BIKETO's size-51 test reported slightly weak lateral frame stiffness, normal vertical stiffness and soft rather than hard pedaling feedback; qualitative build-specific evidence, not a measured deflection result
facts.cockpit: 27.2 mm seatpost; compatible with 1× and 2× drivetrains
facts.frameset_package: Authorized-dealer post lists headset, seat collar, thru axles, stem, bottle bolts, chainstay protector, seatpost, top-tube port cover and brake-mounting bolts
facts.dealer_warranty: Authorized Beijing dealer advertises five years for non-human-damage frame failures; exact buyer eligibility and handling are dealer terms

source_note: The frame claim is 790 g ±3% for a size-51 bike in the VG1 paint, excluding accessories; VG1 is not a carbon grade. A manufacturer-authored 2023 article reported a ¥12,800 mainland package, and current Taobao results provide exact-model purchase routes, but no selected-option checkout was captured. A separate BIKETO exact-model test supplies the construction and ride-stiffness context.
support_note: A direct exact-model retailer route, an official two-year brand warranty page and an authorized-dealer five-year offer are available. The warranty scopes differ, so exact mainland eligibility, proof, exclusions and handling still require confirmation.
